headline_marked: Messi sets world record as [[Argentina beat Jordan 3-1]] to top Group J
headline: Messi sets world record as Argentina beat Jordan 3-1 to top Group J
summary: Lionel Messi becomes the first player to score in seven consecutive World Cup matches as the defending champions secure a perfect group stage record.
details: Argentina defeated Jordan 3-1 in their final Group J World Cup clash in Dallas, finishing at the top of the group with a perfect record.
Captain Lionel Messi came off the bench to score a trademark freekick in the 80th minute, becoming the first player in history to score in seven successive World Cup matches.
Messi now has 19 World Cup goals across six editions and has scored six goals in just three matches in the current tournament.
Before Messi's entry, Giovani Lo Celso opened the scoring in the 19th minute with a freekick, and Lautaro Martinez doubled the lead from the penalty spot in the 30th minute.
These were Argentina's first goals of the tournament from players other than Messi, who had scored all five goals in the opening two matches.
Jordan managed to pull one back in the 55th minute through Musa Al-Taamari, before Messi was introduced in the 59th minute to restore the two-goal cushion.
Argentina will now face debutants Cape Verde in the Round of 32 after the African side progressed as Group H runners-up behind Spain.
caption:
History made in Dallas! 🇦🇷

Lionel Messi becomes the first player ever to score in seven consecutive World Cup matches.

Argentina defeated Jordan 3-1 in their final Group J World Cup clash in Dallas, finishing at the top of the group with a perfect record.

Captain Lionel Messi came off the bench to score a trademark freekick in the 80th minute, becoming the first player in history to score in seven successive World Cup matches.

Messi now has 19 World Cup goals across six editions and has scored six goals in just three matches in the current tournament.

Before Messi's entry, Giovani Lo Celso opened the scoring in the 19th minute with a freekick, and Lautaro Martinez doubled the lead from the penalty spot in the 30th minute.

These were Argentina's first goals of the tournament from players other than Messi, who had scored all five goals in the opening two matches.

Jordan managed to pull one back in the 55th minute through Musa Al-Taamari, before Messi was introduced in the 59th minute to restore the two-goal cushion.

Argentina will now face debutants Cape Verde in the Round of 32 after the African side progressed as Group H runners-up behind Spain.

headline_marked: 3-3 thriller: [[Iran eliminated from World Cup]] after Austria-Algeria draw
headline: 3-3 thriller: Iran eliminated from World Cup after Austria-Algeria draw
summary: A dramatic stoppage-time finish sees Austria and Algeria advance to the Round of 32, ending Iran's hopes of progressing as a best third-placed side.
details: Austria and Algeria played out a thrilling 3-3 draw on Saturday, with two goals scored in stoppage time to secure their spots in the World Cup last 32.
The match reached a peak of drama in added time when Algeria's Riyad Mahrez scored what seemed to be the winner, only for Sasa Kalajdzic to equalize for Austria in the 96th minute.
Argentina topped Group J, while Austria finished second and will now face Spain in the knockout stage.
Algeria advanced as one of the best third-placed sides and will meet Switzerland in the next round.
The game featured goals from Marko Arnautovic and Marcel Sabitzer for Austria, and Rafik Belghali and Riyad Mahrez for Algeria.
The result officially ended Iran's hopes of reaching the knockout stage as one of the best third-placed teams.
The match was played at the Kansas City Stadium, where both teams celebrated the result that allowed them to both progress.
caption:
A 96th-minute equalizer seals a dramatic 3-3 draw, knocking Iran out of the World Cup!

Austria and Algeria played out a thrilling 3-3 draw on Saturday, with two goals scored in stoppage time to secure their spots in the World Cup last 32.

The match reached a peak of drama in added time when Algeria's Riyad Mahrez scored what seemed to be the winner, only for Sasa Kalajdzic to equalize for Austria in the 96th minute.

Argentina topped Group J, while Austria finished second and will now face Spain in the knockout stage.

Algeria advanced as one of the best third-placed sides and will meet Switzerland in the next round.

The game featured goals from Marko Arnautovic and Marcel Sabitzer for Austria, and Rafik Belghali and Riyad Mahrez for Algeria.

The result officially ended Iran's hopes of reaching the knockout stage as one of the best third-placed teams.

The match was played at the Kansas City Stadium, where both teams celebrated the result that allowed them to both progress.
